notes.title: PLAY TOGETHER: PARTY GAMES IS OUT!
notes.content:
- - -  ABOUT THE GAME - - -
Play Together: Party Games is a shared-screen multiplayer experience designed for up to 8 players, where each person uses their smartphone as a controller - no extra hardware or setup required. Just scan a QR code, pick a game, and jump into the fun! 



Online or Local, Play Together: Party Games delivers fast, accessible gameplay perfect for family gatherings, game nights, or office parties.


- - - FEATURES - - -
Smartphone-controlled gameplay - No need for gamepads or downloads.

Multiple mini-games - From trivia and reaction challenges to drawing games and punchlines.

Local or online - Play together in person or connect remotely via stream or call.

Easy to start, hard to stop – Designed for quick rounds and big laughs.


- - - TRAILER - - -

[previewyoutube="pabxUsoajfk;full"][/previewyoutube]

We have 6 minigames. Here are two of them:


1. Knockout | Push other players off the platform using your skills and power-ups.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44857835/86ba9455c0077d50c0dcbf0261d55d9d276e7ac5.png"]

2. AniMatch | Test your attention and reflexes – find the character on your device that matches the one on the screen.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44857835/e5a7dc22b7b3129e9d317f575e2006f52fc696f2.png"]
